title: Root Causes of Fire Incidents Involving Mercedes-Benz Citaro Buses
what_it_is: Root Causes of Fire Incidents Involving Mercedes-Benz Citaro Buses

sections.label: Citaro bus fire investigations
sections.summary: Investigations found Citaro bus fires were caused by failures of different parts within their recommended useful life, with no common cause.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Based on the investigations, the fire incidents involving the Mercedes-Benz Citaro buses were caused by the failure of different parts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: There is no indication of a common underlying cause.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The parts involved were also within their manufacturer-recommended useful life.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Turning to his second and third queries, LTA directed the public bus operators to carry out additional inspections of their Citaro buses.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA is working with the bus operators to enhance the bus inspection regime for older buses and assess whether additional preventive measures can reduce the fire risk.

sections.label: Three fires different causes
sections.summary: Three fires in the first half of the year had different causes, involving a propeller shaft and a turbo-charger.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: For three fires that happened in the first half of this year, there were different causes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: For the first incident, it involved a mechanical failure of a propeller shaft, which then became loose.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: The second incident involved the mechanical failure of a turbo-charger.
